Recording & privacy

FocusFix is still in development. There is no public app download or study enrollment on this website. This page describes the local-only Release build being prepared, not a research consent form.

What a session records

While you choose to record, FocusFix observes activity across apps: keyboard timing and delete-key events, clicks, scrolling, app-switch events, one-second mouse movement summaries, break timing and any optional fatigue/productivity ratings.

It does not save typed text, individual letter keys, application names, window titles, screenshots or cursor paths. Detailed timing can still be sensitive; this data should not be treated as anonymous.

Your controls

A recording notice appears before first use. Accessibility permission lets FocusFix observe input outside its own window. Start a session explicitly, stop it from the window or menu bar, or quit the app. Revoke permission in macOS System Settings whenever you want.

You can turn surveys off in the profile for future sessions. Detailed activity logging pauses during a planned break and resumes at timer expiry or an earlier return.

Where the files stay

The local-only Release build has no research upload endpoint or enrollment. Recordings stay in Application Support/FocusFix/Sessions on your Mac until you delete them. FocusFix does not separately encrypt these files. Your backups and any exports you create may contain copies.

Deleting a session moves its local folder to Trash. Empty Trash to remove that copy; exports and backups are separate. The app does not remove those for you.

Research is a separate step

The development build has a private, enrollment-only upload test. It is not the public download. A research-enabled release needs a reviewed study/consent process, participant contact details and a retention/deletion plan before recruitment starts.

Limitations

FocusFix is an experimental activity tool, not a medical device or a validated fatigue or productivity detector. No analytics scripts, cookies or forms are included in this static website. A future hosting provider may process normal web request logs; its details and a support contact must be added before publication.

Preparation date: October 19, 2026. This information still needs release review.
